# Forsk Coding School Mentors

> Mentor directory for Forsk Coding School in Jaipur, organized by technology domain and linked to relevant learning paths.

This file covers URLs under /mentors/. Use only information visible on a published individual profile page. Do not infer external employer history, degrees, certifications, years of experience or other credentials that are not explicitly stated on the page.

## Mentor directory
- [All Mentors](https://forskcodingschool.com/mentors/): Browse mentors by technology domain.
- [Live MentorLab](https://forskcodingschool.com/live-mentorlab.php): Online + offline learning, live two-way interaction, 10–15 learner micro-batches and practical support.
- [All Courses](https://forskcodingschool.com/courses.php): Match mentor domains with current course pages.

## Discovery
- [Mentor sitemap](https://forskcodingschool.com/mentors/mentors-sitemap.xml): URL inventory for the mentor section.
- [Root LLM guide](https://forskcodingschool.com/llms.txt): Site-wide course and organization context.

## Interpretation guidance
- Treat the individual profile page as the source of truth for a mentor's role and expertise.
- Do not infer or manufacture prior employers, experience years, certifications or education.
- Availability, schedule and course assignment can change; use the visible page or contact Forsk Coding School for current information.
